name: O Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
game_text:
<keyword>Tale</keyword>. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Discard this condition to take off The One Ring or to cancel a skirmish involving the Ring-bearer and a Nazgûl.
flavor_text: “With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.”
